title: UK independent, source-backed expectations for Category 2 map rendering
principle: App-derived outputs are never legal or geographic ground truth. General UK road rules come from GOV.UK; real road shapes require separate current external geodata and local corroboration. Owner UI design preferences are not statutory law.

sources.expectation: Drive on the left unless signs or markings direct otherwise; check carriageway direction rather than assuming roads are interchangeable
Approach and use a roundabout according to posted lane markings and signs; observe priority and actual circulation; distinguish segregated exits
sources.binding: guidance, subject to relevant statutes and local signs

sources.expectation: Do not cut the corner when turning right

sources.section: Along the road; At junctions; Traffic lanes at junctions
sources.expectation: Distinguish central reservation, lane separators, directional arrows, continuous and broken boundaries; combined turn/ahead arrows are possible
sources.binding: official sign descriptions, legal obligations depend on signs and regulations

sources.expectation: A compulsory or prohibited movement shown by a regulatory sign cannot be overwritten by a generic geometric assumption
sources.binding: official signs; actual sign presence requires verification

sources.expectation: Keep left on a motorway except when overtaking, subject to safe exceptions

scenarios.expected: Do not draw an opposite-direction separated carriageway as the active route; keep the car on the direction-compatible source geometry
scenarios.requires: Independent georeferenced same/opposite-way centreline and approach direction

scenarios.expected: A route drawn around a roundabout follows surveyed drivable circulation geometry; shortcutting across the centre is an error
scenarios.requires: Independently downloaded current OSM roundabout geometry plus lane/sign corroboration for legal claims

scenarios.expected: At a close sequence of junction/roundabout exits, the next manoeuvre remains visible and any manoeuvre must respect independently evidenced junction movements
scenarios.requires: External road/layout geometry and a route recording or replay

scenarios.expected: Lower vehicle anchor, smoother transitions and sufficient road ahead are owner product preferences, not statutory requirements
scenarios.requires: Rendered camera and UI occlusion robot measurements

scenarios.expected: Amber/red traffic thresholds are display conventions chosen by the owner, not Highway Code rules
scenarios.requires: Simulated test events rendered through real map controller; no TomTom API key

scenarios.expected: The arrow must occupy the route's carriageway, not the parallel or counterflow one, and heading must match the selected direction
scenarios.requires: Externally sourced geometries with independent sign/marking confirmation

licensing: Public records here contain authored rule summaries and source URLs, not copied maps. If OpenStreetMap way geometry is published, preserve ODbL attribution and source identity.
road_truth_status: Not proven until third-party street geometry and sign evidence are downloaded/validated in a separate fixture or CI job.
